description: Use when an agent or developer needs Sepolia test ETH now, without a faucet login or mainnet history. Input: to (recipient address). Limits per UTC day: 1 SepETH (10 calls) per address, 20 overall, plus stock; all checked before payment. Test ETH has no monetary value. Example: ?to=0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD Price: $0.05 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.
